narrative: Microsoft Build 2026 (Jun 2-3) slating the Windows Agent Framework for MIT-licensed open-source release on day one — alongside Copilot Agent Mode and a Windows Agent Store marketplace — lands a first-party orchestrator with a marketplace surface inside the 5-week venue cohort (Databricks Jun 15-18 with named LangChain speakers, AI Engineer World's Fair Jun 29-Jul 2 with a Harness Engineering track) where bounded-parallel primitives would print.
remaining_gap: Microsoft Agent Framework still needs a published parallel-subagent scaling number; AutoGen, LangGraph, and CrewAI have not yet shipped matching 1k-tier primitives.
